title: Fix CSP Wasm Eval for Scene 3d Models
description: The 3D models are not loading in the compose engine MCP app scene due to a CSP (Content Security Policy) error. The script-src directive is missing wasm-eval, which is needed for WebAssembly-based 3D rendering (likely Three.js/Draco decoder). Need to find where CSP headers are set and add wasm-eval to script-src.
